title: Cicada Vacuum
description: A high, metallic pink/brown-noise riser that climbs a resonant band-pass through the upper register while a tremolo and a stepped gate chop it into stuttering insectoid swarms. Over 16 cycles the noise source darkens, the resonance tightens to a screaming ring, and the gating accelerates before resetting.
code:
setcpm(120/4)
stack(
  s("<pink brown pink white>/4")
    .bpf(saw.slow(16).range(1200, 7800)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(14, 26))
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(5000, 11000))
    .hpf(900)
    .crush("<10 8 6 5>/8").coarse("<1 2 1 4>/4")
    .shape(0.4)
    .tremolosync("<4 8 6 16>/8").tremolodepth(sine.slow(11).range(0.4, 0.95))
    .mask("<1 1 [1 0] [1 0 1 1]>/2")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .delay("0.4:0.1875:0.72").room(0.6)
    .gain(0.8)
    .off(0.0625, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).bpf(9000))
)
